name: Nihongo Quest
pitch: Kana first, then the words, kanji and grammar you need for signs, menus and simple talk, up to JLPT N5.
problem: Learning kanji alone gives you a list of readings to guess from.

stats.label: words in nine stages, all of N5
grammar patterns, each with its lesson

features.title: Japanese in the wild
features.text: Sushi counters, station signs, menus and shop talk, inked in as you learn.
details: A place opens when you can sound out half its words
Order for a friend from a café menu, then hear the bill
Just for practice: nothing here touches your reviews

screen.alt: Out and about: 15 of 15 places open, a word from the street, and cards for the sushi counter, public bath, festival stalls, shop signs and a receipt

features.title: Grammar you can see
features.text: Each pattern is built only from words you already know.
details: Sentences split into topic, when, how, where and verb
Particles explained by what each part is doing
Tap any part to hear it

screen.alt: The Grammar page: 私は 毎日 電車で 駅に 行きます split into topic, when, how, where to and verb, beside cards for the particles

features.title: Play, earn, collect
features.text: Arcade games pay coins for a capsule machine full of Japanese toys.
details: Ninja slice: hear a sound, slice its kana
Look-alikes like さ and ち are the bombs
Three shelves of 20 toys, each named in Japanese

screen.alt: The Games tab: a capsule machine with 220 coins and a shelf of food toys, onigiri, sushi, ramen, dango and taiyaki

features.title: Reading that keeps up
features.text: A ladder from single words to subtitles at real speed.
details: Find the words in a line with no spaces
Every word and sentence can be played aloud

screens.alt: Nihongo Quest's Today page: every hiragana learned, Go deeper practice, progress bars for hiragana and katakana, and words you can read
